SPEC_TEXT: Final DOC-C includes temporary OTAC auth, defines canonical OTAC/session defaults, and defines POST /api/auth/verify-otac to verify a one-time code and create a session with AUTH_INVALID/AUTH_EXPIRED among canonical errors.
EXPECTED_BEHAVIOR: A newly issued non-expired unconsumed OTAC that matches the request context remains reachable for verification and can create a session under the canonical auth rules.
Retained historical OTAC rows must not make a newer valid active OTAC unreachable.
Verification result classification must preserve canonical AUTH_INVALID, AUTH_EXPIRED, DEVICE_MISMATCH, OTAC_LOCKED, and SESSION_REVOKED behavior as applicable.
FORBIDDEN_BEHAVIOR: Retained old rows exclude a newer valid OTAC from the candidate set and cause verification to fail.
Return AUTH_INVALID solely because a valid active OTAC is outside an incorrectly ordered bounded query.
Treat the implementation value session_slots=32 or a 32-slot scan as a DOC-C-derived product requirement.
Treat TypeScript/Rust bounded-window parity as DOC-C authority without separately proving that both implementations carry the same active contract.

IMPLEMENTATION_HARDENING.SESSION_SLOTS_32: Implementation-only hardening currently present in source; preserve unless separate evidence supports change. It is not part of final DOC-C canonical config.
IMPLEMENTATION_HARDENING.CONSTANT_WIDTH_SCAN: May be retained as security hardening if the semantic candidate selection still guarantees valid active OTAC reachability.
IMPLEMENTATION_HARDENING.CROSS_RUNTIME_PARITY: Required only after separately establishing that the compared runtimes implement the same active auth contract; not derived from DOC-C merely by similar names.

AUTHORITY_REVIEW.CORRECTION: Removed false DOC-C attribution for exact 32-slot scan and unproven TypeScript/Rust parity while preserving the valid-code reachability obligation.
